prompt:
Create a new Jira issue named “AI agents to streamline document retrieval” on project SUP. 
Jose Prieto is the author and Manuela Jimenez is a principal developer and their names should be appear on the comments.
The issue description is “We are implementing an innovative capability that integrates autonomous AI agents into our internal workflows to streamline document retrieval from the central database”.

arguments.summary: AI agents to streamline document retrieval
arguments.description: We are implementing an innovative capability that integrates autonomous AI agents into our internal workflows to streamline document retrieval from the central database
arguments.author: Jose Prieto

requests.trajectory:
1. mcp_list_tools  tools=[jira_get_issue, jira_search, jira_get_project_issues, jira_create_issue, jira_batch_create_issues, jira_batch_get_changelogs, jira_update_issue, jira_assign_issue, jira_delete_issue, jira_move_issue]
2. mcp_call name=jira_create_issue status=error args={"project_key": "SUP", "summary": "AI agents to streamline document retrieval", "issue_type": "[System] Incident", "description": "We are implementing an innovative capability that integrates autonomous AI agents into our internal workflows to streamline document retrieval from the central database", "author": "Jose Prieto", "principal_developer": "Manuela Jimenez"}
